about_short_description.short_description: Chatter is an online platform for LLM testing and iteration.

product.name: Chatter LLM Testing Platform
product.description: A platform to build, evaluate, version, and deploy large language model (LLM) workflows with support for complex chains, automatic evaluations, and collaboration.

product.name: Function Builder
product.description: An interface to create and manage a library of function calls for use within LLM chains, with configurable API call settings.

product.name: Routing
product.description: A system to manage complex routing flows involving multiple functions and system prompts for a single query within LLM chains.

product.name: Chat Testing
product.description: A tool to test chat interactions with support for multiple roles, chat import, and evaluation of specific messages within conversations.

product.name: Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) Setup
product.description: A feature to quickly establish RAG pipelines using vector databases or other data sources for document retrieval and generation.

product.name: API Key Vault
product.description: A centralized storage system for managing LLM API keys, token usage, and cost tracking per call or over time.
